verdict.rationale: Omnara exposes a CLI, REST API, and TypeScript SDK for launching and managing agents programmatically, plus webhooks for event-driven automation, which supports headless/automated use (omnara-docs-2, omnara-docs-14, omnara-docs-22, omnara-probe-2). However, there is no explicit CI/CD example (e.g., GitHub Actions, pipeline integration) or documentation calling out CI usage specifically. missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration docs/examples, independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI runs.
